items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Benny Goodman was with us, had joined our group and Davey (Tottenham?).

ctx.x: By this time Benny Goodman was with us, had joined our group and Davey (Tottenham?). And so all the guys said send a wire anyway you know to see if it's on the level. So as I say, I got the wire back with a money order in it. And in those days I know it

was $32.50 for the train fare to New York City. So all the guys saw me off including Benny Goodman (Touph Tottenham, Frank Testemaker, Bud Freeman, my brother Dick and Jim Lanigan) and a lot of other people and family. And I left on a milk train from the South Street Station. (LAUGHTER). I had no idea, I just said I want a ticket to New York.
Were your parents still living then?
